name: Long Live the King
source:
Long Live the King is a short visual novel in which you play as Basil - a royal bastard - taking a chance of his life.

Will he find his way among the royalty and nobility? Will the crown be his? 

[From [url=https://animefanka.itch.io/long-live-the-king]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
国王万岁是一部短篇视觉小说，你在其中扮演巴兹尔 - 一个皇家私生子 - 冒着生命危险。

他能在皇室贵族中找到自己的出路吗？皇冠会是他的吗？

[来自[url=https://animefanka.itch.io/long-live-the-king]itch.io[/url]]
